# Echo string[][]: the result must be the input, exactly.

@example
[["","a b","tab\there","quote\"","back\\slash"],[]]
=> [["","a b","tab\there","quote\"","back\\slash"],[]]

[["newline\nhere","\u00fcn\u00efc\u00f6d\u00e9","\ud83d\ude00"]]
=> [["newline\nhere","\u00fcn\u00efc\u00f6d\u00e9","\ud83d\ude00"]]

[]
=> []

[[""]]
=> [[""]]
